added.t: Howmet may not realize the expected benefits of acquisitions on the anticipated time frame or at all.

On December 22, 2025, Howmet entered into a purchase agreement with Stanley Black & Decker, pursuant to which the Company has agreed to purchase CAM for a cash purchase price of approximately $1.8 billion, subject to customary adjustments.
In addition to the Proposed CAM Acquisition, Howmet may continue to pursue other acquisitions and take other strategic actions to grow or streamline its portfolio.
